RBI/DOR/2026-27/398
DOR.STR.REC.255/21.04.048/2026-27

April 27, 2026

Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks - Asset Classification, Provisioning and Income Recognition) Directions, 2026

1. An asset, including a leased asset, becomes non-performing when it ceases to generate income for the bank. A term loan shall be classified as a non-performing asset if interest and/or instalment of principal remains overdue for a period of more than 90 days.

2. A bank shall classify its non-performing assets into substandard, doubtful and loss assets based on the period for which the asset has remained non-performing and the realisability of the dues.

3. A bank shall make a general provision on standard assets at the rates prescribed in Annex 2 and shall not reckon such provisions in arriving at net NPAs.

(Vaibhav Chaturvedi)
Chief General Manager
